purpose: Press a governor to keep the Crown's work moving, gently or by command

options.text: on the Crown's account, and briefly
in the expectation that we understand one another
for the second time on this matter
and this is the last letter you will get about it

steps.prompt: How the thing is to be put to him

options.label: ask him, and leave the judgement to him
options.text: If {param:to} can spare {param:amount} of {param:resource} this season I should be glad of it, and the Treasury will pay {param:payment}. You are there and I am not; if the moment is wrong, say so and I will hear it{insert:warmth}.

warmth.pleased: , as I have heard you before

options.label: tell him it is expected, and pay for it
options.text: I expect {param:amount} of {param:resource} from {param:to} this season. {param:payment} is set aside against it. I would rather not have to write about it again, and I do not think I shall have to.

options.label: command it, and let him explain himself to his people
options.text: You will have {param:amount} of {param:resource} on the quay by the turn of the season. I am not asking and there is nothing to discuss. What you tell {param:to} about where it went is your affair; I am content that it will be said I required it{insert:cold}.

cold.hateful: , which is no worse than the truth

tone.hateful: Do not make me write again.
